FFmpeg and FFprobe are optional external command-line programs used for media
normalization and inspection. Native release builds copy target-specific static
binaries from the descriptinc/ffmpeg-ffprobe-static release selected by the
build workflow. Those binaries are separate works executed as subprocesses and
are distributed under their own terms. See GPL-3.0.txt and the upstream build
metadata included with release artifacts.

Upstream source and corresponding build materials:
https://github.com/descriptinc/ffmpeg-ffprobe-static
https://ffmpeg.org/

The Podcast Intelligence source code remains licensed under Apache-2.0.
